name: sector_rotation_intraday_v1
author: claude_strategist
thesis: Intraday sector rotation follows a predictable pattern: sectors that lead in the first hour often continue leading, while laggards mean-revert during lunch hour and underperformers catch up in the final hour. This pattern is driven by institutional portfolio rebalancing: morning flow is directional (thematic), while afternoon flow is rebalancing (mean-reverting). By going long the top-2 sectors in the AM and then rotating to bottom-2 sectors in the PM, you capture both effects.
stock_filter: Nifty sector indices (Bank, IT, Pharma, Auto, FMCG, Metal, Realty, Energy) — trade top 3 liquid stocks in selected sector

conditions: AM session (10:15-12:00): go long top 2 sectors by sector_rank (momentum)
PM session (13:00-15:15): go long bottom 2 sectors by sector_return_from_open (mean reversion)
long.confirmation: for AM: sector still in top 2 at 10:15; for PM: sector in bottom 2 at 13:00

conditions: AM session: short bottom 2 sectors by sector_rank
PM session: short top 2 sectors by sector_return_from_open
short.confirmation: same confirmation logic as long, inverted

exit.time_stop: exit AM trades by 12:00; exit PM trades by 15:15
exit.signal_exit: sector rank changes significantly (drops from top 2 to bottom 4 for longs)

filters.volume_filter: sector must have > ₹100Cr aggregate turnover in first hour
filters.trend_filter: for AM momentum: only if nifty50 is not down > 0.5% (not a crash day)
filters.spread_filter: skip if avg spread of top 3 sector stocks > 0.1%
filters.event_filter: skip on budget day, RBI policy
other_filters: minimum 3 bps difference between top and bottom sector returns

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — sector rotation patterns are structural but noisy

weaknesses: Sector rotation patterns are noisy and may not hold in macro-driven markets where all sectors move together
Multiple positions across sectors means higher total capital at risk
PM mean reversion assumes morning overperformers give back gains — but sometimes trends persist all day
prior_art: Intraday sector rotation — institutional portfolio construction concept. Academic support: Moskowitz & Grinblatt (1999) industry momentum.
notes: Requires real-time sector index data. Use Nifty Bank, Nifty IT, etc. as proxies.
